title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-08-31-r33.

This cumulative reader preserves Korean EGA translations that have passed the project's source, translation, typesetting and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme; and a contiguous translation of EGA II §1 through §1.7.14, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1292. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete. No claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, perfection, or external human certification is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean EGA lineage. The exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22208685 identifies this immutable r33 checkpoint. The public working repository is github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Earlier exact-version records remain immutable.

The r33 increment translates complete §§1.7.13–1.7.14, canonical lines 1195–1292. It gives the represented functor Hom_S(X,S[T]) its ring structure and Hom_S(X,V(E)) its module structure, retaining contravariance in X and the compatible ring-and-module morphisms. This interprets S[T] as an S-ring scheme and V(E) as an S-module scheme over it; neither scheme is conflated with the sheaf E. The module-scheme structure then recovers E canonically inside its symmetric algebra by requiring local evaluation h→h(z) to be linear for every open subset and every S-prescheme X. The proof retains the extension of module maps to symmetric-algebra maps, the scalar formula with t^n, and the polynomial-indeterminate argument forcing all graded components except degree one to vanish. Formulas, quantifiers, references, and historical printed-page boundary II 19 remain source-synchronized.

The admitted canonical prefix is 58,385 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 FD1BF48DEEADAF27CEDA1E364240EFB5E4B2ACADE34A2A89BD1F3D108A5E0247. The new 4,834-character source slice is 4,897 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 024612A794E5622ADE5C69C02E7101EF37091C731674AA8AC3C741376F6B263B. The Korean target file is 59,176 bytes, SHA-256 4D5E804AE92FD0DD14C2B1B7D32C1F962827FE11CDB2A5689DF13932C0A84746; its new increment is 4,871 bytes. Next: Proposition §1.7.15.

The cumulative PDF has 234 pages, 1,457,536 bytes, SHA-256 1115FEBE4B30752A1D86D0C4C5336E05927BFF289333C5D7077E714BE12A4103, and retains 223 historical printed-page markers. Release evidence binds editable TeX, cumulative coverage, source authority, terminology decisions, translation controls, reproducible XeLaTeX logs, independent text extraction, link and destination resolution, selected high-resolution renders, and SHA-256 inventories. The build fails closed on source identity, input order, admitted boundaries and target hashes. Legacy Type1 mathematics fonts lack complete ToUnicode mappings: extracted mathematical text is not lossless; TeX and rendered formulas remain authoritative. Hard reproducible checks establish tested properties, not perfection. Confirmed defects and documented uncertainties are corrected in later immutable versions.

Historical creators: Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independent translation is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories, or cited third parties.
